name: vibecheck
description: SomaCheck returns a consented, proposition-specific Aligned or Unaligned reading and model confidence from the person's own phone gesture.

interface.shortDescription: A consented signal when words are the bottleneck.
interface.longDescription: SomaCheck gives your agent a consented body-language signal. Your agent sends one proposition to your phone, you answer with a three-second gesture, and it gets back Aligned or Unaligned with the model's confidence: your body's response to that proposition, against your own baseline. Your agent uses it as meaningful context and makes up its own mind, the same way it would with anything else you gave it. Three ways people use it. Mid-task: when words are the bottleneck, a three-second check-in can re-orient the whole task. Wellbeing check-ins: after hours of grinding, or when you say you are stretched thin, your agent can offer a check-in, only ever with your OK. Big decisions: before you commit, check how your body answers "I'm ready to decide this." Before your first check-in: install the SomaCheck app on your iPhone and sign in with the same account you connect here. The first setup takes about 10 minutes; every check after that takes three seconds. iPhone only for now. A reading is your body's response to that proposition, against your own baseline. It is not a diagnosis. Your agent uses it as meaningful input alongside the conversation and decides what to do with it. It is never used to evaluate another person. Raw motion never leaves SomaCheck.
defaultPrompt: Give me a SomaCheck vibecheck on the decision I'm trying to make, and use the result to help me think it through.
I've been at this for hours. Offer me a SomaCheck check-in if it would help.
Before I commit to this, run a SomaCheck vibecheck on "I'm ready to decide this" and tell me what you notice.
